claim: One unchanged learned global K can expose genuinely different local state-space update laws when label-free sparse support families select approximately invariant coordinate subspaces.

scope.reason: The benchmark has three fixed-point basins with known, genuinely different local matrices; its RK4 one-step map equals the fixed local-matrix polynomial only on the score disk after every score state is verified to remain in its basin-local region and the analytic/environment step agreement gate passes.

frozen_sources.sparse_checkpoint_rule: the existing frozen full-K sign-split p256 roster
frozen_sources.dense_checkpoint_rule: the prospective exact tanh, zero-sparsity, zero-shrinkage, zero-dropout, zero-weight-decay p256 roster

family_discovery.trajectory_corpus: reuse the sparse-card 128-trajectory, length-128 corpus and its fixed 64/64 trajectory split
family_discovery.dense_coordinate_mask: top-k absolute dense coordinates at the paired state, with k equal to the sparse support cardinality

evaluation_geometry.calibration_and_score_relation: independently seeded; set-disjointness is not asserted
evaluation_geometry.family_to_basin_matching: evaluation-only one-to-one Hungarian assignment maximizing calibration assignment counts

primary_estimand.name: decoded_K_minus_I_support_block_local_update
primary_estimand.formula: g_f(x) = D(((E(x) P_f) K) P_f) - D(E(x) P_f)
primary_estimand.near_identity_guard: g_f is identically zero when K=I; errors are normalized by the energy of (J_true-I), not J_true
primary_estimand.state_space_local_matrix: fit the centered 2x2 slope of g_f on the untouched score disk; report intercept and nonlinear residual
primary_estimand.true_candidates: the three known RK4 change matrices R4(dt A_j)-I, each applied about the score basin's center
primary_estimand.distinctness_test: form the 3x3 Frobenius cost matrix from predicted support-selected slopes to true change matrices; the identity assignment must uniquely beat all five nonidentity assignments
primary_estimand.basis_claim: the scored object and loss live in physical state space; support itself remains an intentionally coordinate-dependent property

controls.global_positive_control: D(E(x)K)-D(E(x)) must recover each local change matrix
controls.closure_guard: the support-block and source-only state-space slopes must agree

coordinate_null.role: secondary mechanism specificity, not the primary distinct-law gate
coordinate_null.construction: permute the source code and its projector together with fixed sign-pair-preserving coordinate permutations while K and D remain fixed

controls.wrong_support_excluded: Applying another family's source projector to the same state can win trivially by erasing source activity, so it is not an estimand.
controls.dense_control: repeat the complete assignment test with sparse-cardinality-matched dense tanh coordinate-mask families; call these masks, never natural supports

sparse_specificity_gate.precondition: all three exact dense runs pass family and geometry validity
sparse_specificity_gate.row_metric_per_seed: sparse block.max_own_over_nearest_wrong divided by the paired dense block.max_own_over_nearest_wrong
sparse_specificity_gate.assignment_metric_per_seed: sparse block.identity_over_best_nonidentity divided by the paired dense block.identity_over_best_nonidentity
sparse_specificity_gate.seed_aggregation: all three paired valid seeds must individually pass both ratios; no mean or median aggregation
sparse_specificity_gate.dense_ineligibility_branch: report that no stable cardinality-matched dense family comparison was available; do not count numeric sparse-specificity gates as passed

decision_branches.strong_distinct_laws_sparse_specific: All sparse distinct-law and exact-dense specificity gates pass. Claim that one unchanged K contains support-selected local update laws on this controlled benchmark, with no claim of exact invariant subspaces or universality.
decision_branches.strong_distinct_laws_not_sparse_specific: Sparse distinct-law gates pass but dense specificity fails. Claim one-K capacity and learned state-space law recovery, not sparsity-specific causation.
decision_branches.global_map_only: The full model recovers the three laws but support-block identification or closure fails. Claim nonlinear encoder/decoder plus global K capacity only; do not attribute laws to sparse supports.
decision_branches.invalid: Family matching, local linearity, anchor, checkpoint, or analytic-map validity fails. Report the failed gate without reading it as evidence for or against distinct support laws.
decision_branches.failed: Validity passes but the identity law assignment or effect-size gates fail. Do not claim distinct support-selected laws.
